Eight additional non-atomic writers remain as static-audit observations, not named-target blockers. Recorded in probe2 raw output.
Neither atomic primitive fsyncs the parent directory, and marketplace write_json does not explicitly fsync the temp file; process-kill atomicity does not establish sudden-power-loss durability.
